/jee-mains/q/a-particle-moves-along-a-st.text: A particle moves along a straight line with a velocity v = t^2 - 4. Find the distance traveled between t=0 and t=4s.
/jee-mains/q/a-particle-moves-along-a-st.explanation: Distance is integral of |v|dt. Velocity is negative from 0 to 2, and positive from 2 to 4. Integrate |t^2 - 4| in two parts.
/jee-mains/q/a-particle-moves-along-a-st.subject: Physics

/jee-mains/q/which-of-the-following-comp.text: Which of the following compounds exhibits both Frenkel and Schottky defects?
/jee-mains/q/which-of-the-following-comp.explanation: AgBr (Silver Bromide) is the unique compound that shows both types of point defects in solids.
/jee-mains/q/which-of-the-following-comp.subject: Chemistry

/jee-mains/q/what-is-the-dimensional-for.text: What is the dimensional formula of Magnetic Flux?
/jee-mains/q/what-is-the-dimensional-for.explanation: Flux = B * Area. F = qvB => B = F/qv = [MLT^-2]/[AT][LT^-1] = [MT^-2A^-1]. Flux = [MT^-2A^-1][L^2] = [ML^2T^-2A^-1].
/jee-mains/q/what-is-the-dimensional-for.subject: Physics
